BiblicalUsage: Baleh means worn out, and it describes the Gibeonites' trick: old sacks, old wineskins, old shoes and old clothes, all worn out to make it look as though they had come from far away.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the worn-out clothes are a warning about believing appearances, because Israel made a covenant on what they saw and never asked the Lord.
